text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. We want a big photo gallery of the cafe AND a detailed story section about each of our three coffee farms. Keep costs low.

@Requester The brief names the sections but not the content. I need the facts below before I can write a checkable charter.
1. What is on the menu? Please list each item with its price in rupees, grouped as you want it shown (for example Coffee, Cold, Food).
2. What are your opening hours for each day, the full street address in Indiranagar, and the phone number to show?
3. For each of the three coffee farms, what are its name, location and story text? Also, do you have the cafe photos for the gallery, and roughly how many?
4. How should a pickup pre-order reach you and be paid for?
   Option 1: Form sends the order to a WhatsApp number, pay at pickup
   Option 2: Form sends the order to an email address, pay at pickup
   Option 3: Online payment at order time
   Option 4: Other (please describe)
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

1. Menu (prices in ₹):
Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220
Cold: Cold brew 200
Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130

2. Hours: 8am to 10pm every day.
Address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038. Phone: +91 80 4000 2468.

3. Farms:
- Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur: a family estate growing shade-grown Arabica at 1,400 m, known for natural-process lots with fruity notes.
- Kerehaklu, Chikmagalur: a fourth-generation farm that replants native forest trees and grows coffee alongside pepper and cardamom.
- Baarbara Estate, Coorg: a small estate that hand-picks only ripe cherries and dries them slowly on raised beds.
Photos: none yet. Use simple drawings for now, about 6 gallery spots.

4. Option 1: the form sends the order to WhatsApp +91 98450 00000, pay at pickup. Pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.

@Requester The charter leaves out these items from your brief: Real cafe photos: none exist yet, so the gallery uses simple drawings in 6 spots, as the Requester instructed.; Farm stories beyond the supplied facts: the Requester gave one description per farm, so each story is built only from those facts and no extra detail will be invented.. Work starts after your answer.

proposal.name: Page shell, menu, hours, location and gallery
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists. Visitors cannot see the menu, hours, address, phone or gallery, and there is no navigation.
proposal.expected_outcome: A responsive one-file page with a header and nav, plus menu, hours, location and gallery subsections, each with its own id. The nav links to all six section ids, including the pre-order and farms ids that later workflows will create. Menu has exactly the 6 supplied items in ₹. Hours are 8am to 10pm daily. Address is 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 and phone is +91 80 4000 2468. The gallery has 6 inline SVG drawings in a large grid, each with alt text. Base CSS covers 360px and 1280px with no horizontal overflow.
proposal.completion_check: Menu lists exactly the 6 supplied items and prices. Hours, address and phone match the charter. Gallery shows 6 images with non-empty alt text. All nav hrefs resolve to existing ids once the other workflows are registered. No horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px. No JS errors on load.

proposal.name: Three coffee farm story blocks
proposal.goal_gap: The farms section is missing. The charter needs three separate stories built only from the supplied facts.
proposal.expected_outcome: A farms section with three separate blocks: Ratnagiri Estate (Chikmagalur), Kerehaklu (Chikmagalur) and Baarbara Estate (Coorg). Each uses only the supplied facts, with no invented detail.
proposal.completion_check: Exactly 3 farm blocks, each with its name and location. Each block contains only the supplied facts: shade-grown Arabica at 1,400 m and natural-process fruity lots for Ratnagiri; fourth-generation, native tree replanting, pepper and cardamom for Kerehaklu; small estate, hand-picked ripe cherries and slow drying on raised beds for Baarbara. The section has an id that the nav links to.

proposal.name: Pickup pre-order form via WhatsApp
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot place a pickup order.
proposal.expected_outcome: A pre-order section with a quantity input for each of the 6 menu items and a name field. On submit it opens a wa.me link to +91 98450 00000 with a prefilled message listing the chosen items, quantities and name. It validates that a name and at least one item are present. It states that payment is at pickup and that pickup is within 15 minutes of ordering.
proposal.completion_check: Submitting with a name and at least one item opens a wa.me/919845000000 URL whose text contains each chosen item, its quantity and the name. Submitting with no name or no items is blocked with a visible message. The section text states payment at pickup and pickup within 15 minutes. No JS errors on load or on submit. No horizontal overflow at 360px.
